summary.text: Luke Meerman is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives, first elected in November 2018, representing District 89 in Ottawa, Muskegon and Kent counties.
He chairs the House Oversight Subcommittee on Child Welfare System.

paragraphs.text: Meerman is a lifelong resident of the 89th House District, a small business owner and a fifth-generation dairy farmer.
He previously served as a Polkton Township trustee, first elected in 2012, and was a board member and vice president of the Ottawa County Farm Bureau.
During his second term he chaired the bipartisan School Safety Task Force, and he has co-chaired the Legislature's Working Group on National Security since 2023.
He lives in Coopersville with his wife, Victoria; they have five children and have fostered 15 children.
